approval_scope: The ten source/document files below at these hashes; source-review approval only. No native build, Swift typecheck, simulator capture or upload approval is asserted.
checks: DEBUG hooks and new implementation are conditionally compiled; release view initialization remains Today and normal WatchSync activation remains the existing path.
Today and metronome remain existing native SwiftUI pages; capture seeds WatchSnapshot and starts the real WristMetronome timer. No image composition or fake system face added.

Exact per-launch UUID, requested language, revision, page, applied-label dictionary, native pixels and state checks reject stale prior-process probes; current foreground state is required while publishing. Before/after timestamps bracket capture and native decode.
All 49 language/page pairs and 50 distinct store locales are enforced. Unsupported store locales ms, or-IN and zh-Hant truthfully use English; paths retain capture-language provenance.

Native PNG uses public help-derived black-mask capability; original media bytes are retained. CRC, bounded decompression, unfiltering, decoded dimensions and actual opacity are checked; native ImageIO decode is required on capture and validation. Alpha-channel presence is independently recorded and flagged for upload review.

Fresh pair/device identifiers are used for build, install, launch and screenshot. Template selection requires available installed runtime/device, and no arbitrary booted simulator fallback exists. Pairing/build/launch failure prevents manifest creation.

Workflow is manual-only, read-only repository permission, no persisted checkout credential, no account/signing/upload action. Shell revision arguments are quoted and subprocess arguments use lists. Artifact patterns preserve partial logs, probes and untouched media.
Watch face remains genuine manual follow-up and is not included in captured-image counts or claimed as an Apple minimum-media blocker.
